chunks.text: A Green Grocer is a shop where you can buy fresh fruits and vegetables.
If you want to shop at a Green Grocer in an English -speaking country, you need to know how to ask for prices, quantities, and pay for your items.
Common Vocabulary for Fruits and Vegetables First, let's learn the names of common fruits and vegetables in English.
Fruits, Apple, Banana, Orange, Strawberry, Grape, Watermelon, Pineapple, Vegetables, Tomato, Carrot, Potato, Onion, Lettuce, Broccoli, Cucumber.
Now that we know the names of fruits and vegetables, let's learn how to ask for prices and quantities.
When you go to a Green Grocer, you need to ask how much things cost and how much you want to buy.
Here are some simple ways to do that.
What's the price of the tomatoes?
Can I have one kilo of apples, please?
Can I get half a kilo of potatoes?
These phrases will help you order what you need.
Paying for Your Items After choosing your fruits and vegetables, it's time to pay.
Here's how you can do it.

Can I get two cucumbers and a bunch of grapes?
